source.text: A solid that is free to expand (no gap closure, free axially) grows by u = alpha (T - Tref) r: for a long free-ended cylinder the surface strain is alpha times the area-mean temperature rise, whatever Poisson's ratio. Fuel alpha 1e-5 per K, mean rise 300.237 K, last fuel cell centre at 3.9975 mm.
source.check: FEED's real-solver test (tests/mechanicsSolver.test.ts, free thermal expansion) reproduces u = alpha dT r to 0.2 % and its independent thermo-elastic solution (src/core/thermoElastic.ts, checked against Timoshenko and Lame) agrees with every result.

coverage.domain: synthetic pin at 10 W/m in a 600 K coolant, both solids linear elastic (E 200 GPa, nu 0.3) stress-free at 300 K, constant conductivities; thermo-elastic, small strain, no creep, plasticity or swelling; fuel alpha 1e-5 per K, cladding alpha 17e-6 per K, free axially, the 20 micron gap stays open
